method: Unique provider/request_id; same call saved per utterance/cache counted once; known token lower bound; no-ID attempts and gateway unmatched calls separate; entire recorded report history incl later repairs.
scenario_assumptions: Reference projection only: replace old providers by workload role while retaining observed input/output token totals. No new-model replay has been run.
Basic: live summaries/classification, chunks, initial structure, ontology/review, detailed narratives. High: reduction, consolidation and whole-meeting synthesis.
Includes intermediate report versions and later repairs through extraction time; assigning all of this to one day is a capacity scenario, not the historical daily spend.
No token savings credited to OpenRouter and no failure-token savings deducted. Actual tokenizers, reasoning lengths and retries can differ.
Unrecorded timeout/HTTP failures and overwritten metadata mean measured totals are lower bounds, not a worst-case cap.
30% is an illustrative sensitivity margin, not a measured error bound.
Other projects share allowances and are not included in these meeting scenarios.

Account-listed daily allowance: 10M mini group and 1M group containing GPT-5.4. GPT-6.1 Sol daily-free eligibility is unconfirmed; budget its escalation calls against monthly promotional credits. Eligibility alone does not confirm data-sharing enrollment.
limitations: Only provider/request_id-attributable responses counted in meeting call totals. These are not all upstream attempts.
Gateway HTTP failures without a provider response ID cannot be reliably assigned to an individual meeting.
Token counts are provider-returned totals, not externally verified invoices.
Validation-failed tokens include partially accepted responses; they cannot all be treated as removable waste.
Legacy failure-table attempts are per item/aggregate and may overlap retries; do not add them to unique API-call counts.
Final raw structure JSON counts differ from the current read projection; final_projection is the user-facing derived count.
No actual four-broadcast/new-model load test or 1,000-distinct-issue test was executed.
Official transcript comparisons, STT, personal alerts, other projects and unrelated reports are outside the meeting-attributable budget unless explicitly included.
NIM/Gemini/Groq preflight rate/budget/input-size skips are not equivalent to paid/consumed API requests.
Organization daily quota uses UTC 00:00 / KST 09:00. Meeting on_broadcast_date uses the Korean calendar day.

sol_price_estimate_assumptions.notes: Illustrative repricing of old token counts, not actual GPT-6.1 usage. Standard tier, no cache discount/write/tool/regional charges. All integration priced as paid even though eligible free tokens could offset it.

account_eligibility_correction.planning_policy: Treat GPT-6.1 Sol as billable and reserve against verified remaining monthly promotional credit, until account billing or OpenAI support confirms daily-free eligibility.
account_eligibility_correction.scenario_interpretation: Existing gpt_shared_integration fields describe integration workload token proxies, not confirmed GPT-6.1 daily-free coverage. Use them for GPT-5.4 capacity planning; estimate GPT-6.1 escalations separately against monthly credit.
